series_noise_floor.method: half of the observed three-run AGW range divided by its median

minimum_detectable_effect.method: full observed three-run AGW range divided by its median; operational, not a confidence interval

reason: The single Envoy result lies within the AGW three-run observed spread; this series cannot distinguish a gateway-specific difference.
repeat_rationale: The once-per-series AGW n=3 noise-floor pilot is complete; another run is not justified solely by a delta within its observed spread.
